picks.title: Who is Narrating the Future? AI and the Audiobook Market
picks.excerpt: Frankfurter Buchmesse white paper by Dosdoce.com: 85 audio experts, 85% use AI somewhere in production but only 17% across six or more phases; reported savings 20-50%, far below vendor claims.
picks.rationale: First hard numbers on how far AI has actually moved into audiobook production workflows, and where it stalls.

picks.title: How AI wiped out an entire industry in Nairobi
picks.excerpt: At least 40,000 Nairobi writers made a living drafting academic papers; after ChatGPT prices and orders collapsed, and what remains is 'humanizer' work rewriting AI text.
picks.rationale: The clearest case study yet of a writing trade erased by a general model, and of the humanizing work that replaces it.

picks.title: Secrets of Effective Upskilling
picks.excerpt: An excerpt from Ann Medaille's ALA Editions book argues that with AI and automation reshaping library work, formal training covers only 10% of learning; the other 90% needs experiences, exposure and environment.
picks.rationale: A concrete operating model for retraining a whole staff while AI shifts the job under them.

picks.title: New Directions Seminar: What Is a Journal in 2030?
picks.excerpt: SSP's New Directions Seminar puts editorial judgment in an AI-enabled environment at the center of its program, asking publishers to co-create the near-term future rather than wait for it.
picks.rationale: Frames the live question for any editorial org: what is left of human judgment once AI sits inside the workflow.

picks.title: Book, News, and Journal Publishers File Amicus Brief in In Re Mosaic LLM Litigation
picks.excerpt: AAP, News/Media Alliance and STM filed an amicus brief in In Re Mosaic LLM Litigation, urging Judge Charles Breyer to deny Mosaic and Databricks' summary-judgment motion and hold that training LLMs on copyrighted books is not fair use.
picks.rationale: Publishers' trade bodies put the argument in writing: training expressive works to make competing expressive output is not transformative. Recovery pass pick.
